clause_2_single_case_widening.detail: Widened verify_stale_archive_resurrection_proof in scripts/ai_status.py by exactly one case: authenticated local operator reopen (Human/Ops with operator_mode: local_human_ops and authenticated event_id against payload digest) followed by zero delivery and no review invalidation stays eligible. Pre-reopen events must be notes, reassignments, or imports. Post-reopen events must be allowed runtime/worker coordination events (wake_queued, worker_worktree_allocated, worker_started, worker_governance_lease_preserved, worker_lost_lease, worker_lost_lease_recovery_held, worker_lost_lease_recovery_pending, worker_promotion_continuation_pending, blocker, note, task_reassigned) with strictly zero delivery/commit fields. Active task must have no delivery_binding, no review_file, and unchanged branch. Generation transitions across reopen are validated to preserve owner and reviewer continuity.

All CLI runs exit non-zero and leave active row, archive snapshot, and terminal facts untouched.
